intro: What Atlas may trade on the OKX demo account. Market Scout starts each morning from the instruments that pass these settings.

off.stock_perp: Stock, ETF and index perpetuals are off

classNote: Turning a class off stops new trades in it. Open positions stay until they close.
volNote: Trading volume over the last 24 hours, in US dollars. USDC counts as dollars.
spreadNote: A basis point is 0.01%. A wider spread costs more to trade.
avoid: Avoid stock perpetuals outside US hours
hoursNote: Stock perpetuals trade around the clock on OKX, with thinner books outside US hours.
wlSub: Market Scout picks up to this many each morning, and may pick none.
allowNote: When this list has instruments, Atlas trades only these. Leave it empty to let Market Scout choose from everything that passes.
allowOnly: Only these instruments can be traded. Each still has to pass every filter above, and the blocklist wins.
denyNote: Atlas never trades these. A block also removes the instrument from today’s watchlist, and it wins over your pins.
place: Add an instrument, such as XAU-USDT-SWAP
unknownInst: {{text}} isn’t in the OKX demo universe.
searchFailed: Couldn’t search the instruments. Try again.

fail.blocked: Also blocked, and the blocklist wins
fail.unknown_instrument: Not in the OKX demo universe
fail.not_live: Not trading on OKX right now
fail.listed_under_7_days: Listed on OKX less than 7 days ago

failFirst: Atlas checks the first {{n}} allowed instruments.

err.empty: Enter an amount in US dollars.
err.spread: Enter a spread from 1 to 100 bps, with at most 1 decimal place.
err.perDay: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.

savedBody: Market Scout and the Risk Engine use them from now on.
failedBody: Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so nothing changed. Try again.
fixFields: Fix the highlighted field and save again.

conflict.title: These settings changed in another window
conflict.body: They are now version {{v}}. Your changes are kept on top of it; review them before saving.

activityNote: Every change is a new settings version. Market Scout reads the newest one each morning.

error.title: Couldn’t load the market settings
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
